An adversary hence has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 35 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 35 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 4413 identities would post 919 proofs and burn roughly 12 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
